verdict.rationale: The only event-triggered rule in the evidence is Infra Analytics alerts that catch regressions. Autotune automatically shifts traffic toward winning variants based on a metric, which is automated but not a user-defined rule. Scheduled rollouts are time-based rather than event-based. missing for 10: user-defined event-to-action rules (e.g. auto-disable a gate on a metric regression), webhooks or action triggers on gate/experiment events, documentation of alert actions beyond notification, and hands-on corroboration.
